title: Build a "Mentor Time-Saving" Guide
description: Mentors are the backbone of bootcamps and struggle with scattered feedback. Write a tutorial for mentors on how to use Zedu's threads and channels to give feedback on projects efficiently, instead of switching between WhatsApp and email.
